comparison: md5-simd fused NEON batch vs sequential md5-simd digest
root_causes: single-message APIs intentionally use the serial single-stream backend
pick_batch rejects fewer than four messages and short messages below the measured crossover
adjacent-only scheduling misses non-adjacent equal lengths
underfull tail groups duplicate lanes or fall back to scalar work
gather/transpose and padding overhead dominate only at small workloads
multi-group K broadcasts were repeated per group; shared-K repair is now present
conclusion: AArch64 NEON has a real advantage whenever enough independent equal-length work reaches the fused kernel. The apparent no-advantage cases are dispatch/workload boundaries, not a blanket NEON kernel failure.
